question: In the budget for the Financial Year (FY) 2025-26, the Government has announced launch of a comprehensive multi-sectoral ______ programme. The programme aims to address under-employment in agriculture through skilling, investment, technology and invigorating the rural economy.
solution: The correct answer is __**Rural Prosperity and Resilience**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • In the **budget for the Financial Year 2025-26**, the Government of India has announced the launch of a comprehensive multi-sectoral program named **Rural Prosperity and Resilience**. • The primary aim of this program is to address **under-employment in the agriculture sector** through a combination of skilling, technology adoption, investment, and boosting the rural economy. • This initiative focuses on integrating multiple sectors such as **agriculture, rural entrepreneurship, and allied industries** to create a sustainable rural ecosystem. • The program emphasizes **empowering rural youth** with new skills and promoting innovations in agricultural practices to enhance productivity and resilience. • The scheme also seeks to strengthen infrastructure and support systems in rural areas to **foster economic growth and reduce migration** to urban centers.
